assumptions.cash_basis: Cash receipts/payments; no additional working-capital adjustment.
assumptions.cash_shortfall: Negative cash is unmet funding; no automatic equity injection, refinancing or debt-service forgiveness.
assumptions.cfads: Receipts minus opex, supplied cash taxes and maintenance capex; construction capex excluded.
assumptions.dscr: Monthly diagnostic CFADS/(interest+contractual principal capped by opening debt), null if service is zero; not a legal covenant determination.
assumptions.facility: Nonrevolving cumulative-draw limit; repayments do not restore headroom; availability_end enforced.
assumptions.interest: Opening debt times nominal annual interest rate divided by 12; draws occur at month end.
assumptions.not_modelled: Fees, reserves, intra-month liquidity, tax law, FX, refinancing, distributions and off-balance contingent obligations.
assumptions.percentiles: P10 lower, P50 median, P90 upper. Monthly quantiles are not a single coherent joint path.
assumptions.point_forecast: Expected component amounts through a nonlinear financing waterfall; not necessarily expected closing cash.
assumptions.scenario_delay: Shift remaining unobserved physical/operating cash schedules; equity and principal dates stay fixed. A construction delay only before operations begin.
assumptions.tax: Cash tax schedule supplied as input; scenario multipliers do not recalculate statutory taxes.
assumptions.uncertainty: Conditional lognormal shocks, AR(1)=0.65, common innovation variance share=0.35, plus persistent parameter shocks. Model-conditioned, not real-world calibrated probabilities.

warnings: Fixture contains withheld future actuals; forecasts must use only the as-of prefix.

limitations: Conditional simulation ranges are not empirically calibrated confidence intervals.
Synthetic demonstration results do not establish real-project forecasting accuracy.
The fixed forecast horizon can leave delayed cash flows outside the reported period.
Scenario probabilities are model-conditional, not credit default probabilities.
Monthly DSCR is illustrative; contractual covenant definitions require separate implementation.
LLM mode only chooses predefined tool actions; all published figures come from verified code.
